newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Great Ocean scraps dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Great Ocean scraps dividend plan.

text.p: Shareholders of the Shenzhen Great Ocean Shipping Co Ltd have rejected the board of directors' 1996 dividend proposal, the company said on Thursday in a statement.
Great Ocean's shareholders voted to make no dividend for 1996, against the planned 0.08 yuan per share, the statement, published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, said.
The company said it would use the money instead to finance development but gave no details.
The shipping company's 1996 net profits dropped a year-on-year 29.75 percent to 35.6 million yuan from 50.7 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards, it had said.
